feed.subtitle: Changes to what we measure. Nothing is published here unless a state actually changed.

entry.title: Public website: a fault in our own checking, not in the service
entry.content: Our own check looked for a sentence that had been rewritten on the site. The page was serving normally in about a quarter of a second. The check now looks for something the page structure carries rather than something a writer edits. We recorded Public website changing from operational to a partial outage at 2026-08-20T15:56:24.373Z, and that reading was our own, so the entry is kept and corrected rather than deleted.

entry.title: Published websites: a fault in our own checking, not in the service
entry.content: The same bot filter, once the prober learned to recognise it. This entry records our check becoming honest about being blocked, not a change in the service. We recorded Published websites changing from a partial outage to unknown, because we could not measure it at 2026-08-19T04:59:51.437Z, and that reading was our own, so the entry is kept and corrected rather than deleted.

entry.title: Published websites: a fault in our own checking, not in the service
entry.content: Our own check was stopped by a bot filter in front of the sites, and graded that as the sites being broken. Every published website was serving normally throughout. We recorded Published websites changing from operational to a partial outage at 2026-08-19T04:51:29.486Z, and that reading was our own, so the entry is kept and corrected rather than deleted.

entry.title: Website studio: a fault in our own checking, not in the service
entry.content: Our own check was wrong, not the studio. It expected the page to refuse an unauthenticated visitor and the page correctly served one, so the check called a working page a partial outage. Fixed in the prober the same day. We recorded Website studio changing from a partial outage to operational at 2026-08-18T21:12:13.380Z, and that reading was our own, so the entry is kept and corrected rather than deleted.
